text_fidelity_a:
Acer Chromebook 15, Intel Atom X5-E8000 Quad-Core Processor, 15.6" HD, 4GB LPDDR3, 16GB eMMC, CB3-532-108H Though I received this Acer Chromebook for review, I have another one exactly like it that I bought refurbished about a month ago and have been using it a lot. They are both the same make and model. What I like:

1. The battery life is exceptionally long. I can get a long play list going and it will run all night with nearly a full battery in the morning. I'm using Bluetooth earbuds and I darken the screen so I'm sure that helps to save on battery power.
2. Connects quickly with all my Bluetooth earbuds (and I have several). Only one set of earbuds won't connect and I am still trying to figure that out.
3. Boots up quickly - very short wait time.
4. Screen is nice and big and easy to see.
5. Touchpad works great.
6. Keyboard feels good to use and I'm a very fast typer.
7. It was easy to get it started and on-line right out of the box. It didn't ask me for a billion passwords.

What could be better:
1. Sound is rather weak and really not very good.
2. Screen quality (color, brightness, clarity, etc....) is average
3. Seems to be kind of slow going from site to site....my desktops are much faster.
4. It seems this Acer chromebook doesn't send a Bluetooth signal (weaker) as far as my old Haier chromebook. If I want to listen to something while in bed I have to move the Acer to the bottom of the stairs so the signal will reach. Never had that problem before.

But, for the price of this chrombook (as of this review it's around $179.00) I think it's an excellent buy. It comes with a power cord (of course) but that's it. It uses the Chrome web browser and all I want it for is to check a few sites, write reviews and cruise Youtube. It would be great for college/high school students and anyone who doesn't mind storing their data in the cloud. My main reason for using Chromebooks is that you don't have to buy anti-virus for them since they can't download any data so working off line is not feasible.

It seems to be constructed well and I'm happy with the refurb, but now hubs can use one to surf the web too.
text_fidelity_b: Acer Chromebook 15, Intel Atom X5-E8000 Quad-Core Processor, 15.6" HD, 4GB LPDDR3, 16GB eMMC, CB3-532-108H

text_fidelity_a:
Power Strip with 3 USB, KPSTEK Flat Plug Extension Cord with 2 Widely Spaced Outlets, Desktop Charging Station for Home, Office, Dorm Essentials, Black - KS2312 This is a combination product with a 5 foot extension cord, 2 AC power outlets, and 3 full-sized USB power ports. Compact size is great for travel, since older hotels don't have enough power outlets for modern travelers and the outlets are often hidden behind desks or under beds.

Unfortunately, the USB power ports are pretty weak. You get 2.4A divided among 3 ports, so if you're trying to charge 3 devices, each one gets less than 1A. Modern smartphones and tablets will often fast-charge at 3A, so charging with these ports will be very slow. USB powered laptops can use even more power and will complain about being charged at less than 3A.

I don't like that there is no USB-C charging port and no USB Power Delivery fast charging, which are becoming the standard for smartphones and laptops.

This device is not UL listed for electrical safety. As phone and tablet and laptop batteries get more and more powerful, electrical safety becomes more and more important. Most power strips from US brands are UL listed, so I cannot recommend a product that is not UL listed.
text_fidelity_b: Power Strip with 3 USB, KPSTEK Flat Plug Extension Cord with 2 Widely Spaced Outlets, Desktop Charging Station for Home, Office, Dorm Essentials, Black - KS2312

The voices are clear and it depends whether you use Logitech viewing or Skype, but Logitech has a more refined lip movement to voice coordination. Again...this is a perfect picture!

You can make several adjustments, and the light adjustment is automatic, the mic is noise cancelling, however, I have not the need to test that yet.

What I like is that anytime someone on your contact list is at the computer, you can have a small message pop up that lets you know they are available. My two current contacts are using Windows XP; while I am on Windows Vista.

If you are someone you know is vascillating between getting a Webcam, I encourage them to do so, especially if they have family miles away like I do. Many people do not like to be on camera, and for me, I don't either because I have to look decent an any moment a call comes in. Try it.... You may like it! ....Rizzo

So, now it tells me to get off my chair and walk around and does EKG and stress tesing and Oxygen levels..
I was concerned that the 41 mm might be too small, but it is a great size for me as you can see from the pic. I have had a Citizen Echo Drive for more than 10 years and it is a little larger, but I like the size of the Watch 3 better.
If you are thinking about getting a watch, this one is a good deal right now and I believe it does work best if you use it with a Samsung phone.
